daemon.needsApproval: Hermesh’s background service can run once you allow it in System Settings › Login Items.
daemon.noResponse: Hermesh’s background service isn’t responding. It usually starts on its own; if this keeps happening, reopen Hermesh.

personal.connectMessage:
Please connect yourself to my computer (Hermesh):
1. Install: curl -fsSL https://github.com/hermeshai/hermesh/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh -s -- --cli
2. Sign in: ~/.local/bin/hermesh auth login {{address}} --name "{{name}}"
3. Tell me the verification code shown on screen. Once I confirm it on my Mac, you’re ready.
Then use hermesh project list to see the projects you can use, hermesh session start --project {{project}} --prompt "…" to start working, and hermesh --help for every command.
personal.connectLink: Connect to Hermesh: follow {{url}}. Your name in Hermesh is “{{name}}”.

health.processesBody: Its processes are at their limit ({{used}} / {{limit}}): Hermesh can’t start coding agents, and sessions sent to it fail. It recovers by itself once the program holding them quits.
health.processesBodyCulprit: Its processes are at their limit ({{used}} / {{limit}}); {{count}} of them are ended processes {{culprit}} never cleaned up. Hermesh can’t start coding agents, and sessions sent to it fail. Quit {{culprit}} and it recovers by itself.
health.processesBodyNear: Its processes are near their limit ({{used}} / {{limit}}). At the limit, Hermesh can’t start coding agents.
health.processesBodyNearCulprit: Its processes are near their limit ({{used}} / {{limit}}); {{count}} of them are ended processes {{culprit}} never cleaned up. Quit {{culprit}} before Hermesh can’t start coding agents.
health.diskBody: Only {{free}} left. Once it is full, new sessions can’t get a worktree and sessions can’t be saved.
health.filesTitle: Hermesh on {{name}} is running out of open files
health.filesBody: {{used}} of {{limit}} open files. Restarting Hermesh helps; if it keeps happening, copy the diagnostics and send them to us.
health.shellPathTitle: Can’t read the PATH of {{name}}’s Terminal
health.shellPathBody: {{detail}}. Coding agents installed with nvm, npm and the like may not be found. Check whether a new Terminal window starts slowly or waits for input; Hermesh tries again every minute.
